test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pakhu Itu dance is performed by the Apatani tribe of which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Pakhu Itu dance is performed by the **Apatani tribe**.
 
• The Apatani tribe is indigenous to the **Ziro Valley** in the state of **Arunachal Pradesh**.
 
• This dance is a part of their traditional **cultural heritage** and is performed during various **festivals and celebrations**.
 
• The Apatani tribe is known for their unique **agricultural practices** and sustainable living.
 
• They are also noted for their distinct **facial tattoos and nose plugs** which are part of their ancient customs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Assam**__

 __
 
• Assam is known for its **tea gardens** and is a major producer of tea in India.
 
• The state is home to the **one-horned rhinoceros** found in Kaziranga National Park.
 
• Assam's culture is rich with **Bihu dance** being a famous traditional dance.
 
 
 
• **Himachal Pradesh**__
 __
 
• Himachal Pradesh is famous for its **hill stations** such as Shimla and Manali.
 
• The state is known for its **apple orchards** and scenic landscapes.
 
• It is also popular for its **Kullu Nati dance**, a traditional dance of the Kullu region.
 
 
 
• **Chhattisgarh**__
 
 
• Chhattisgarh is rich in **tribal culture** and has a significant population of indigenous tribes.
 
• The state is known for its **Bastar Dussehra**, one of the longest festivals in India.
 
• It is also famous for its traditional **folk dances** like Panthi and Raut Nacha.
